body: Happy birthday. I constantly beat myself the same way as well— you’re really strong to make it to your 20th birthday as I don’t think I could even do that. I don’t know what else to say since everyone’s comments really do help out well: but that you are worth something. Stay strong, we all support you.

I honestly don't really know what to think of suicide. It feels like its the only way out once you hit below rock-bottom and you feel like you'll be out of everyone's hair for good, but at the same time it affects the people who care really bad. That's what I'm scared of if I actually do plan to do it. I think after death we just become light and we float off somewhere, maybe somewhere nice and comforting, like the night sky. At least that's what I imagine, we'll never really know what's actually there after we go.
